name: Teen DMs for Kids
what_you_do: Be the Dungeon Master for kids' Dungeons and Dragons games at the library. Guide the story, teach the rules and be a role model. You need some D&D knowledge, but not DM experience.
who_can_apply: Teens 13 to 18 who know some D&D. Teens who live or go to school in Vancouver get first pick. You need an adult reference who is not your parent or guardian.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. You earn community service hours.
duration: Varies. Times and branches change, and some are one-time events.
deadline_text: No deadline. Apply at least one week before a program starts. Chances come up now and then, and the library contacts teens it picks.
how_to_apply: Fill in the application form on the Teen DMs page and give the contact for an adult reference (a coach, teacher, counsellor or community leader). Questions: teens@vpl.ca.
notes: Some times of year are busier than others, so you may wait a while for your first game.
